description: Gemini-3.6-Flash voice annotations for chavo character-class LoRAs (TTS-AGI/moss-race-loras). id = raw training identifier / HF adapter folder; human_name = display name. Grid demos: 5 neutral + 1 cheerful + 1 angry line per class, no reference.

cavernous-gravel-beast.one_sentence_impression: An immensely deep, booming monster voice dominated by guttural throat rasp and heavy chest resonance.
cavernous-gravel-beast.detailed_sentence: This voice features an exceptionally low masculine pitch register saturated with thick back-of-throat growl, massive bass resonance, and a gritty, cavernous texture that retains its iconic monstrous weight even when shifting into excited or aggressive emotional states.
cavernous-gravel-beast.perceived_age: Middle-aged to ancient (~45-60), conveying timeless monstrous power and gravitas.
cavernous-gravel-beast.register: Extremely low pitch height with a deliberate, commanding cadence in neutral speech that expands into explosive dynamic pitch surges during high-intensity lines.

timbre_profile.summary: An extraordinarily dark, heavy, and rough timbre grounded in powerful chest resonance and intense guttural friction.

cavernous-gravel-beast.distinctive_features: Dominant and authoritative presence; deliberate, heavy-footed speech rhythm; distinct throat growl and sub-harmonic rumble on vowel sustained sounds.
cavernous-gravel-beast.emotional_range: Exhibits broad and believable emotional flexibility, transitioning seamlessly from a threatening neutral rumble to a booming, joyfully exaggerated cheer and a fiery, roaring roar of anger without breaking character.

timbre_profile.summary: Deep, dark chest-dominant voice with moderate gravelly throatiness and impressive low-end resonance.

resonant-iron-commander.distinctive_features: Deliberate, rhythmic phrasing; commanding vocal weight; gravelly texture on line endings; clear sibilance without harshness.
resonant-iron-commander.emotional_range: Delivers convincing emotional breath, raising pitch and warmth for bright cheerful lines while deepening into a booming, threatening growl for angry scenes.

guttural-abyssal-fiend.register: Extremely low sub-bass pitch register with deliberate, heavy cadence and aggressive pitch swells when shouting.
